verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents its own Meter Events / Billing Meters API for sending customer usage events and billing on them, so the core ingestion capability exists. Nothing in the pack covers the high-volume, idempotency or backdating parts of the story. missing for 10: evidence of high-volume streaming throughput, idempotent ingestion (deduplication identifiers), backdated event timestamps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream high-volume usage events — API calls, tokens, compute-seconds — into a metering pipeline with idempotent ingestion and backdating support

citations.quote: Meter events represent actions that customers take in your system. You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
Basic usage-based billing, built on the Billing Meters API, is a lower-level primitive that remains fully supported for existing integrations.
